fact: The study included 4744 patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) who were enrolled between February 15, 2017, and August 17, 2018.
fact_zh: 该研究纳入了4744名患有射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）的患者，他们于2017年2月15日至2018年8月17日之间入组。
quote: Patients with New York Heart Association classification II to IV with an ejection fraction less than or equal to 40% and elevated plasma N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide were enrolled between February 15, 2017, and August 17, 2018,

fact: The primary outcome was the composite of an episode of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death.
fact_zh: 主要结局是心力衰竭恶化事件或心血管死亡的复合终点。
quote: The primary outcome was the composite of an episode of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death.

fact: Among participants without diabetes, the primary outcome occurred in 171 of 1298 (13.2%) in the dapagliflozin group and 231 of 1307 (17.7%) in the placebo group.
fact_zh: 在无糖尿病的参与者中，达格列净组1298人中有171人（13.2%）发生主要结局，安慰剂组1307人中有231人（17.7%）发生主要结局。
quote: Among participants without diabetes, the primary outcome occurred in 171 of 1298 (13.2%) in the dapagliflozin group and 231 of 1307 (17.7%) in the placebo group

fact: In patients with diabetes, the primary outcome occurred in 215 of 1075 (20.0%) in the dapagliflozin group and 271 of 1064 (25.5%) in the placebo group.
fact_zh: 在糖尿病患者中，达格列净组1075人中有215人（20.0%）发生主要结局，安慰剂组1064人中有271人（25.5%）发生主要结局。
quote: In patients with diabetes, the primary outcome occurred in 215 of 1075 (20.0%) in the dapagliflozin group and 271 of 1064 (25.5%) in the placebo group

fact: Volume depletion was reported as an adverse event in 7.3% of patients in the dapagliflozin group and 6.1% in the placebo group among patients without diabetes.
fact_zh: 在无糖尿病的患者中，达格列净组7.3%的患者报告了容量减少作为不良事件，安慰剂组为6.1%。
quote: Volume depletion was reported as an adverse event in 7.3% of patients in the dapagliflozin group and 6.1% in the placebo group among patients without diabetes

fact: A kidney adverse event was reported in 4.8% of patients in the dapagliflozin group and 6.0% in the placebo group among patients without diabetes.
fact_zh: 在无糖尿病的患者中，达格列净组4.8%的患者报告了肾脏不良事件，安慰剂组为6.0%。
quote: A kidney adverse event was reported in 4.8% of patients in the dapagliflozin group and 6.0% in the placebo group among patients without diabetes

fact: Dapagliflozin significantly reduced the risk of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death independently of diabetes status.
fact_zh: 达格列净显著降低了心力衰竭恶化或心血管死亡的风险，且与糖尿病状态无关。
quote: dapagliflozin compared with placebo, when added to recommended therapy, significantly reduced the risk of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death independently of diabetes status.

fact: The trial was conducted at 410 sites in 20 countries.
fact_zh: 该试验在20个国家的410个地点进行。
quote: Exploratory analysis of a phase 3 randomized trial conducted at 410 sites in 20 countries.

fact: The study included 2605 (55%) patients without diabetes.
fact_zh: 该研究纳入了2605名（55%）无糖尿病的患者。
quote: Patients with New York Heart Association classification II to IV with an ejection fraction less than or equal to 40% and elevated plasma N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide were enrolled between February 15, 2017, and August 17, 2018, with final follow-up on June 6, 2019.

fact: The primary outcome was analyzed by baseline diabetes status and, in patients without diabetes, by glycated hemoglobin level less than 5.7% vs greater than or equal to 5.7%.
fact_zh: 主要结局按基线糖尿病状态进行分析，并在无糖尿病的患者中按糖化血红蛋白水平低于5.7%与高于或等于5.7%进行分析。
quote: This outcome was analyzed by baseline diabetes status and, in patients without diabetes, by glycated hemoglobin level less than 5.7% vs greater than or equal to 5.7%.
